column1: # Import-direction rules, enforced by the `imports` lane on non-test imports.
# Why the layers are what they are: docs/architecture.md ("Layers and import rules").
# The Go compiler already rejects import cycles, and Go's internal/ rule keeps
# devtools/internal/ out of reach of the product code.
#   importer, targets: package paths relative to the module; `x/...` matches x
#   and every package below it. Targets are comma-separated; `-` means none.
#   only    the importer may import first-party packages matching the targets, nothing else
#   forbid  the importer may never import packages matching the targets
# A rule whose importer or a target matches no package fails the lane.
